tests: Choosing a storage class for automatic cost optimization with unknown, changing access and no lifecycle rules.
expected: S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves objects between tiers based on actual access. Triggers: "access patterns unknown and change over time", "without managing lifecycle rules".
why_not: Standard does not optimize on its own; Glacier Flexible Retrieval — for known archives; One Zone-IA — single AZ and assumes infrequent access.
